customer_name: China Iron and Steel Research Institute Group
business_problem: China Iron and Steel Research needed a practical way to apply large-model capabilities across materials R&D and manufacturing processes, turning its industry datasets and expert knowledge into deployable metallurgy intelligence rather than isolated experiments.
solution_summary: China Iron and Steel Research and Baidu AI Cloud built the metallurgy industry's first process-perception large-model platform using Qianfan ModelBuilder, the BaiGe AI compute platform, and related private-stack products. The solution follows an IPS-style three-layer architecture and uses capabilities from Qianfan, BaiGe, Yijian, and Zhenzhi to connect core platform services with business applications. Rather than aiming at one generic chatbot, the project chose representative metallurgy tasks from micro, meso, and macro perspectives and then validated model capability through specific workflows such as metallographic analysis, surface-defect inspection, and material tracking. The platform also optimized Kunlun-based compatibility with Qianfan and BaiGe so private delivery could be completed quickly.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model development platform used to build and validate metallurgy workflows.

solution_components.name: BaiGe AI Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the AI training and serving infrastructure for the metallurgy model platform.

solution_components.name: Yijian
solution_components.role: Contributes platform capabilities used to connect products and industry applications in the IPS architecture.

solution_components.name: Zhenzhi
solution_components.role: Provides additional platform services used in the integrated metallurgy solution stack.

data_flow: Industry datasets, image data, and tracking inputs are processed through the metallurgy platform, where Qianfan and BaiGe support model training and capability validation. The resulting workflows drive metallographic analysis, surface-defect inspection, and material tracking outputs for industrial users.
business_outcome: China Iron and Steel Research established a reusable metallurgy AI platform, improved several key industrial workflows, and created a domestic-industry example of large-model deployment in heavy manufacturing.
metrics: The defect workflow processes 2,000 images in 100 seconds.
Material-tracking MOTA reached 95%+ and MOTP reached 90%+.
architecture_clues: The private deployment follows an IPS three-layer architecture
The project optimized Kunlun compatibility across Qianfan, BaiGe, and Yijian for fast delivery
Representative workflows cover micro, meso, and macro industry perspectives
evidence_quotes: China Iron and Steel Research and Baidu built the metallurgy industry's first process-perception large model to support the sector (original: 联合打造冶金行业首个流程感知大模型).

The platform uses an IPS three-layer architecture and integrates the core capabilities of Qianfan, BaiGe, Yijian, and Zhenzhi from product to application (original: 通过IPS三层架构的整体规划…依据千帆、百舸、一见、甄知等平台的核心能力，实现从产品到应用的深度融合).

The team validated the platform in metallographic analysis, surface-defect detection, and material tracking, and optimized Kunlun compatibility for fast delivery (original: 在金相分析、表面缺陷检测和物料跟踪的行业场景实践中，通过平台完成了业务的快速搭建和模型的能力验证。完成了昆仑芯与千帆、百舸和一见等平台产品线的优化提升).
Key results included 97.30% metallographic accuracy, 95%+ surface-defect precision, and 100 ms response for material tracking (original: 金相分析…准确率:97.30%；表面缺陷检测…模型精确率≥95%…物料跟踪…模型响应速度100ms).
